commit_message: Implement ADR 0131 native local read harness
pr_title: Implement ADR 0131 native local read harness
pr_body:
## Summary
- add a native read-only local-model question harness with loopback-only Ollama-compatible transport
- retrieve current GameEngine/project evidence and retain source provenance plus harness metrics in conversation answers
- expose local-model setup in AI Studio while keeping write-capable Go on the external AgentRuntime boundary
- regenerate the change from current main after PR #91 advanced the baseline, preserving the new VFX builder module

## Validation
- request Windows affected validation for engine-editor
- request Editor visual validation for the AI Studio UI changes

Supersedes Draft PR #93, whose validated baseline became stale after main advanced.
